topics.name: Vulnerability Response Applications and Modules
topics.description: Understand the Vulnerability Response application architecture, key modules, and how they integrate with the broader Security Operations suite.

introduction.overview: The ServiceNow Vulnerability Response application helps security teams manage vulnerability data and operations teams resolve vulnerabilities efficiently. It integrates with third-party vulnerability scanners and provides a centralized platform for tracking, prioritizing, and remediating vulnerabilities.
introduction.whyItMatters: Applications and Modules accounts for 25% of the CIS-VR exam. Questions focus on understanding the core VR components, how vulnerability data flows through the system, and integration with other Security Operations applications.
introduction.keyConcepts: Master the Vulnerability Response data model, understand how Vulnerable Items relate to CIs, and know the role of Vulnerability Groups. Be familiar with the Exception process and how VR integrates with Configuration Compliance.
introduction.examTips: Pay attention to the relationship between vulnerabilities and configuration items. Know the difference between Vulnerable Items (records) and Vulnerabilities (definitions). Understand how VR uses CMDB data for context.

topics.name: Getting Data into Vulnerability Response
topics.description: Learn how vulnerability scanner data is imported, transformed, and matched to configuration items in the CMDB.

introduction.overview: Vulnerability Response relies on data from third-party vulnerability scanners. Understanding how this data is ingested, parsed, and matched to CMDB records is essential for a functioning VR implementation.
introduction.whyItMatters: Data Ingestion covers 25% of the CIS-VR exam. This topic tests your knowledge of import processes, data sources, matching rules, and how scanner integrations work.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand the import set process for vulnerability data, how CI matching works, and the role of data sources. Know the common scanner integrations (Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7) and their configuration.
introduction.examTips: Focus on the matching process - how vulnerability scanner assets are matched to CMDB CIs. Know what happens when matches fail and how to handle orphan records.

topics.name: Tools to Manage Vulnerability Response
topics.description: Master the tools and interfaces used to manage, prioritize, and track vulnerability remediation activities.

introduction.overview: Vulnerability Response provides various tools for security and operations teams to manage vulnerability remediation. These include workspaces, lists, filters, and reporting capabilities.
introduction.whyItMatters: Management Tools represent 23% of the CIS-VR exam. Questions focus on how to use VR effectively in day-to-day operations, including prioritization and workflow management.
introduction.keyConcepts: Know the Vulnerability Response workspace, understand how to use filters and saved searches, and be familiar with bulk operations. Understand the remediation workflow and task assignment.
introduction.examTips: Be comfortable with the VR workspace navigation. Know how to filter by severity, age, and CI type. Understand the difference between viewing vulnerabilities vs vulnerable items.

topics.name: Automating Vulnerability Response
topics.description: Configure automated workflows, business rules, and integrations to streamline vulnerability remediation processes.

introduction.overview: Automation is key to handling the volume of vulnerabilities in enterprise environments. VR provides multiple automation options including flows, business rules, and orchestration integrations.
introduction.whyItMatters: Automation covers 20% of the CIS-VR exam. This tests your ability to configure automated responses, task creation, and integration with remediation tools.
introduction.keyConcepts: Understand how to use Flow Designer for VR automation, configure automatic task assignment, and set up notifications. Know when to use business rules vs flows.
introduction.examTips: Focus on practical automation scenarios: auto-assigning tasks based on CI ownership, escalating critical vulnerabilities, and triggering remediation workflows.

topics.name: Vulnerability Response Dashboards and Reports
topics.description: Create and configure dashboards and reports to communicate vulnerability status to stakeholders.

introduction.overview: Effective vulnerability management requires clear visibility into the current state and trends. VR includes pre-built dashboards and the ability to create custom reports.
introduction.whyItMatters: Reporting accounts for 7% of the CIS-VR exam. While a smaller percentage, understanding how to present vulnerability data to different audiences is important.
introduction.keyConcepts: Know the out-of-box VR dashboards, understand how to create custom reports, and be familiar with Performance Analytics indicators for VR.
introduction.examTips: Focus on the built-in dashboards and what metrics they display. Understand how to customize reports for different stakeholder needs (security, operations, executives).
